outcome: Beginning of labor (ambiguous, possibly duration of pain onset)
Duration of labor (ambiguous, possibly duration of analgesia effectiveness)
cohort: The participants were 150 puerperae who underwent prenatal examinations and cesarean section.
finding: Sufentanil plus dexmedetomidine effectively maintained hemodynamic stability and limited the secretion of pain mediators, resulting in lower pain scores and reduced analgesic consumption following cesarean section, without marked changes in placental hypoxia-inducible factors or oxidative stress responses.
